$comment: Palier 1 quality gate (#2438). Single source of truth for thresholds, read by check-quality-ratchet.ts.
Ratchet: a zone metric (cognitive complexity / duplicated lines per 1000 SLOC, measured by coderot) may not exceed the value here + tolerancePer1k.
Lower a value in the same PR that improves the zone: `pnpm check:quality --write` (never raises). Raising needs a documented owner exception.
Tolerance 0.5 absorbs 0.1-rounding and clone-detection noise between merge commits (one extra complexity-15 function adds ~0.2 per 1k in the smallest zone).
exceptions: functions allowed above functionCap, each with a reason. See docs/guides/quality-ratchet.md.
